entities.name: Annie Funk
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Annie Clemmer Funk was an American Christian missionary and one of the more than 1500 people who died in the sinking of RMS Titanic. Since 1906, she had been a missionary in the Janjgir-Champa district in Chhattisgarh, India. She was on her way to visit her ailing mother.
